title: Register or notify the food premises with the council
what: Register the food premises with the local council (classes 1-3 each year) or notify it once (class 4), before trading.

sources.title: So, you want to run a food business? Guide for Victorians
sources.locator: What do food laws mean for me?
sources.quote: A business that sells food in Victoria must register the place where they sell or prepare the food - their ‘food premises’ – with the relevant local council.
